$comment: 语法大厅 G32（V0.9 P3 进阶层，非谓语三课收官）。比喻锚点：interesting 是发声者，interested 是听众。只讲初中层面辨析（感受词成对 -ing/-ed、分词作定语的位置、作表语选牌、固定搭配），不堆砌复杂例外；末尾承接 G30/G31 并统一预告精修层 G46 非谓语综合辨析合流。暗线：报时权一句只发一张。全部内容原创。
title: 分词作定语与表语（-ing / -ed）
metaphor: interesting 是发声者，interested 是听众
ketNote: 老实说：KET 只在 interested / boring 这类高频词上顺带见到分词，不单独设考点。系统的分词用法是初中重头戏——这课收齐非谓语三张脸，为初中/PET 打底，学到就是赚到，不用焦虑。

sections.essence: 动作当形容词：-ing 是发声者（令人…的），-ed 是听众（感到…的）。
sections.why: 中文一个「无聊」两头通吃：「这部电影真无聊」和「我好无聊」用的是同一个词，谁制造无聊、谁感到无聊，全靠听的人自己分。英语不肯这么省：它把动作 bore（使人厌倦）铸成两张牌——发出影响的一方戴 -ing（The film is boring），接受影响的一方戴 -ed（I am bored）。牌一挂反，意思立刻反过来：I am boring 说的是「我这个人很无趣」。所以分词不用死背，先问一句：它是发声者，还是听众？KET 只顺带见到这些词，初中和 PET 才大量考——这课把非谓语的第三张脸补齐。
sections.metaphorStory: 银帆乐团首演散场，学徒负责给后台挂牌子。师傅交代：「今晚的曲子打动了很多人——给曲谱挂 moving 的牌，它是发声者；给擦眼泪的观众挂 moved 的牌，他们是听众。」学徒记成了「人一律挂 -ing」，转头给打瞌睡的自己挂了块 I am boring。师傅路过笑出声：「你这是向全团宣布『我是个无趣的人』。你想说的是 I am bored——无聊是曲子发出的，你只是接收到了。」学徒赶紧换牌，又问：「牌子挂哪儿？」师傅说：「单个词挂在名词前面，像 a sleeping baby；一串词就跟在名词后面紧贴着，像 the boy standing by the drum——离远了，观众就不知道这块牌子是谁的。」

cards.detail: bore / interest / excite 这类「使人…」的动词：-ing 给发出影响的一方（令人…的），-ed 给接受影响的一方（感到…的）。
cards.example: The film is boring. → I am bored.

cards.rule: 成对记：八对高频感受词
cards.detail: interesting/interested · boring/bored · exciting/excited · surprising/surprised · tiring/tired · moving/moved · confusing/confused · relaxing/relaxed。
cards.example: The trip was tiring, so we were tired.

cards.rule: 作定语一：单个分词站名词前
cards.detail: -ing 表主动进行（正在…的），-ed 表被动完成（被…过的）。
cards.example: a sleeping baby（在睡的宝宝）· the broken window（被打破的窗）

cards.rule: 作定语二：分词短语跟在名词后并紧贴
cards.detail: 分词带了自己的小尾巴（宾语/状语），整串放到名词后面，必须紧挨着被修饰的词。
cards.example: the boy standing at the gate · a song written by our teacher

cards.detail: be / feel / look / sound 后接分词：主语是发出影响的（事/物）用 -ing，主语是接受影响的（多是人）用 -ed。
cards.example: The news sounds exciting. / We all feel excited.

cards.detail: be interested in · be excited about · be surprised at · be tired of——介词各有各的，整块背下最稳。

basic.cn: 这个故事很有意思。（故事是发声者，戴 -ing）
我对音乐感兴趣。（我是听众，戴 -ed）
看那只睡着的猫。（单个分词站名词前）

basic.en: The excited children ran to the stage.
basic.cn: 兴奋的孩子们跑向舞台。（孩子接收兴奋，-ed）

basic.en: Running water is cleaner than still water.

mid.en: The boy standing at the gate is my cousin.
mid.cn: 站在门口的男孩是我表哥。（短语后置紧贴）

mid.en: This is a song written by our music teacher.
mid.cn: 这是我们音乐老师写的一首歌。（被写的歌，-ed 短语后置）

mid.en: The movie was so moving that many people cried.
mid.cn: 电影感人至深，很多人都哭了。

mid.en: We were surprised at the ending.
mid.cn: 我们对结局很吃惊。（固定搭配 be surprised at）

mid.en: The girl playing the drum is only seven.
mid.cn: 打鼓的那个女孩才七岁。

trap.en: The trip was tiring, but nobody felt bored.
trap.cn: 旅途很累人，但没人觉得无聊。
trap.note: 一句两张牌：旅途发出 tiring，人接收 bored——两头不能换。

trap.en: I am bored, not boring — please believe me.
trap.cn: 我是感到无聊，不是无趣的人——请相信我。
trap.note: boring 挂人身上=「这人无趣」，牌挂反意思全反。

trap.en: The window broken by the ball has been repaired.
trap.cn: 被球打破的那扇窗已经修好了。
trap.note: broken 短语后置修饰 window——它同时也是 G29 被动里的那块状态牌。

trap.en: Boiled water is safe to drink; boiling water can hurt you.
trap.cn: 烧开过的水能放心喝；正滚着的开水会烫伤人。
trap.note: boiled 已烧过（完成），boiling 正在滚（进行）——一字之差两种水。

trap.en: I heard some exciting news about the concert.
trap.cn: 我听到了关于音乐会的令人兴奋的消息。
trap.note: news 是发出影响的一方——挂 -ing，别因为自己兴奋就写 excited news。

trap.en: The children were confused by the confusing rules.
trap.cn: 孩子们被这些让人糊涂的规则弄糊涂了。
trap.note: 同一个动作两张牌同台：规则发出 confusing，孩子接收 confused。

redBlack.bad: You are very boring here, right?（想说：你在这儿一定很无聊吧）
redBlack.good: You are very bored here, right?
redBlack.why: boring 挂人身上成了「你这人很无趣」——想关心人反成冒犯，发出与接收全反了。

redBlack.bad: I am very interesting in playing the piano.（想说：我很感兴趣）
redBlack.good: I am very interested in playing the piano.
redBlack.why: interesting 让你从「感兴趣的听众」变成自夸「我这人很有趣」——意思整个跑偏。

redBlack.bad: The film was so bored that I fell asleep.
redBlack.good: The film was so boring that I fell asleep.
redBlack.why: 电影是发出影响的一方——boring；bored 是留给看电影的人的牌。

redBlack.bad: We are all exciting about the school concert.
redBlack.good: We are all excited about the school concert.
redBlack.why: 人接收影响——excited；搭配也固定：be excited about。

redBlack.bad: Look at the boy stands under the tree.
redBlack.good: Look at the boy standing under the tree.
redBlack.why: 一句只有一个主奏报时（Look）——修饰男孩要用分词短语 standing…，紧贴其后。

redBlack.bad: This is a letter writing in English.
redBlack.good: This is a letter written in English.
redBlack.why: 信是被写的——接受方用过去分词 written；writing 成了信自己在提笔。
消息发出惊讶——-ing；surprised 留给听到消息的人。

redBlack.bad: Please give me some boil water.（想说：开水）
redBlack.good: Please give me some boiled water.
redBlack.why: 动词想当形容词必须先换装——烧开过的水是 boiled water。

redBlack.bad: She was surprising at the result.
redBlack.good: She was surprised at the result.
redBlack.why: 她是接收方——surprised；固定搭配 be surprised at。

redBlack.bad: He is tired of get up early.（想说：厌倦了早起）
redBlack.good: He is tired of getting up early.
redBlack.why: of 是介词——门后只收打包件 getting（G31 的门规在分词搭配里照样生效）。

redBlack.bad: The window is broken.（有人说必须说 was broken 才对）
redBlack.good: is broken / was broken 都对，说的事不同。
redBlack.why: is broken 说「窗现在是破的」这个状态；was broken 说「被打破」那个动作——语境定牌，不算错。

redBlack.bad: an interested look（有人觉得 -ed 只能形容人）
redBlack.good: an interested look（感兴趣的神情）说得通。
redBlack.why: 神情、眼神可以「带着兴趣」——不挡意思，考试也不设坑。

contrast.cn: 这部电影真无聊。／我好无聊。（一个词两头用）
contrast.en: The film is boring. / I am bored.
contrast.diff: 中文「无聊」不分发出与接收；英语铸成两张牌，挂错就反。

contrast.cn: 激动的观众／激动人心的比赛（都是「激动」）
contrast.en: the excited audience / an exciting match
contrast.diff: 中文靠「人心」二字悄悄区分；英语直接换牌 -ed / -ing。

contrast.en: boiled water（烧开过的）/ boiling water（正滚的）
contrast.diff: 中文模糊过去；英语必须选：完成 -ed 还是进行 -ing。

contrast.cn: 站在门口的男孩（修饰语再长都在前面+「的」）
contrast.en: the boy standing at the gate（短语搬到后面）
contrast.diff: 中文修饰语一律前置；英语一长就后置，还必须紧贴名词。

contrast.cn: 我对画画感兴趣。（一个「对」走天下）
contrast.en: I am interested in drawing.（in 不能换）
contrast.diff: 中文介词全能；英语每个搭配的介词各有各的，整块记。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 先问发出还是接受：发出戴 -ing，接受戴 -ed；单个站名词前，一串跟名词后。
steps: 找到分词形容的对象：它是发出影响的（令人…），还是接受影响的（感到…）？
发出方戴 -ing：boring film · exciting news · moving song。
接受方戴 -ed：bored student · excited fans · moved audience。
当定语看长短：单个分词站名词前；带尾巴的短语放名词后，必须紧贴。
be / feel / look 后选牌：回到第 1 步问主语是谁。
收尾自查：不规则动词的第三形态回 G13 查——written、broken，别写成 wrote、broke。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，英语把感受分成两张牌：发出感受的一方戴 -ing，接到感受的一方戴 -ed。咱们玩挂牌游戏：我说一个场景，你告诉我两张牌各挂给谁。比如『电影很无聊，你看得直打哈欠』——boring 挂给电影，bored 挂给你。我不懂英语没关系，我只听词尾：说自己的感受，结尾是 d 的音；说事情本身，结尾是 ing 的音。要是你说 I am boring，我就喊『牌挂反啦』。」再加一关：家里找三样东西让孩子挂牌造句——an interesting book、a relaxing song，说得出谁发出谁接收才算过。
questions: 「电影很无聊」和「我很无聊」，英语各用哪张牌？为什么不能换？
a sleeping baby 里 sleeping 站在哪？the boy standing at the gate 为什么搬到后面去了？
I am interesting in music 错在哪？该怎么改？

sections.echo: 到这一课，非谓语的三张脸集齐了：G30 的 to do 是还没演的节目单，G31 的 doing 是打包成东西的活，这一课的 -ing/-ed 是挂在名词身上的状态牌。三张脸三套规矩，背后是同一条铁律——报时权一句只发一张，主奏之外的动词一律冻结。而 -ed 那张牌，又一次落回 G13 那批最常用的老团员：written、broken、made，第三形态照样不讲理。规律与例外的这笔账，到精修层 G46（非谓语综合辨析）三张脸正面交锋时一起算清。

stages.name: 认一认 · 发声者还是听众

questions.q: The music is relaxing. 这句里 relaxing 的牌挂在谁身上？
questions.explain: 音乐让人放松——发声者戴 -ing。

questions.q: I am relaxed. 这句里的 relaxed 说明「我」是？
options: 发出影响的一方（发声者）
questions.explain: 我接收到了放松——听众戴 -ed。

questions.q: 「令人兴奋的」用哪张牌？
questions.explain: 发出影响的一方戴 -ing——exciting。

questions.q: 「感到兴奋的」用哪张牌？
questions.explain: 接受影响的一方戴 -ed——excited。

questions.q: boring 和 bored，哪个形容「无趣的电影」？
questions.explain: 电影发出无聊——boring film。

questions.q: interested 这张牌一般挂在谁身上？
questions.explain: 接收方（人）戴 -ed——interested。

questions.q: 「令人惊讶的消息」是？
questions.explain: 消息发出惊讶——surprising news。

questions.q: 「被感动的观众」是？
questions.explain: 观众接收感动——moved audience。

questions.q: 「累人的一天」是？
questions.explain: 这一天发出疲惫——tiring day。

questions.q: a sleeping baby 里的 sleeping 表示宝宝？
questions.explain: -ing 分词作定语表主动进行——正在睡的宝宝。

questions.q: the broken window 里的 broken 表示窗户？
questions.explain: -ed 分词作定语表被动完成——被打破的窗。

questions.q: 单个分词作定语，一般站在名词的？
questions.explain: 单个分词像普通形容词——站名词前面。

questions.q: 分词短语（带小尾巴的一串）作定语，要放在名词的？
questions.explain: 一长就后置，还必须紧挨被修饰的名词。

questions.q: be interested 后面固定搭配的介词是？
questions.explain: be interested in——整块记。

questions.q: be surprised 后面常接的介词是？
questions.explain: be surprised at——整块记。

questions.q: confusing / confused 这对牌来自哪个动作？
questions.explain: 感受动词 confuse 铸成两张牌：confusing 发出、confused 接收。

questions.q: The film was really ___, so we left early.
questions.explain: 电影发出无聊——boring。

questions.q: I felt ___ after the long rehearsal.
questions.explain: 我接收疲惫——tired。

questions.q: The ending of the story was ___.
questions.explain: 结局发出惊讶——surprising。

questions.q: We were all ___ at the strange ending.
questions.explain: 我们接收惊讶——surprised，搭配 at。

questions.q: Listening to soft music is ___.
questions.explain: 听音乐这件事发出放松——relaxing。

questions.q: The ___ children jumped and cheered.
questions.explain: 孩子接收兴奋——excited children。

questions.q: Look at the ___ baby — don't wake her up.
questions.explain: 正在睡的宝宝——sleeping，单个分词站名词前。

questions.q: They are repairing the ___ window.
questions.explain: 被打破的窗——broken；broke 是过去式不能当牌。

questions.q: The girl ___ the piano over there is my sister.
questions.explain: 女孩主动在弹——playing 短语后置紧贴 girl。

questions.q: This is a photo ___ at the school gate.
questions.explain: 照片是被拍的——taken 短语后置。

questions.q: Amy is interested ___ collecting song sheets.
questions.explain: be interested in——介词固定。

questions.q: The players were excited ___ the big win.
questions.explain: be excited about——介词固定。

questions.q: Do you know the man ___ in front of the hall?
questions.explain: 修饰 the man 用分词短语 standing——一句只有一个主奏。

questions.q: I'd like a cup of ___ water, please.
questions.explain: 要喝的是烧开过的水——boiled water。

questions.q: The song ___ by the band last year is popular now.
questions.explain: 歌是被写的——written 短语后置；wrote 是过去式。

questions.q: His speech was so ___ that some people cried.
questions.explain: 演讲发出感动——moving。

questions.q: 哪一句的牌挂对了？（我对下棋很感兴趣）
options: I am interested in playing chess.
I am interesting in playing chess.
I am interested at playing chess.
questions.explain: 人接收兴趣戴 -ed，介词固定用 in。

questions.q: 哪一句的牌挂对了？（这部纪录片很无聊）
questions.explain: 片子发出无聊——boring。

questions.q: 哪一句的牌挂对了？（我们对比分很吃惊）
options: We were surprised at the score.
We were surprising at the score.
We were surprised in the score.
questions.explain: 人接收惊讶 surprised，搭配 at。

questions.q: 哪一句的牌挂对了？（站在门口的男孩是我同学）
options: The boy standing at the gate is my classmate.
The boy stands at the gate is my classmate.
The boy stand at the gate is my classmate.
questions.explain: 一句只有一个主奏 is——修饰男孩用 standing 短语后置。

questions.q: 哪一句的牌挂对了？（这是一封用英语写的信）
options: This is a letter written in English.
This is a letter writing in English.
This is a letter wrote in English.
questions.explain: 信是被写的——第三形态 written。

questions.q: 哪一句的牌挂对了？（决赛令人兴奋）
questions.explain: 比赛发出兴奋——exciting。

questions.q: 哪一句的牌挂对了？（疲惫的乐手们早早睡了）
options: The tired players went to bed early.
The tiring players went to bed early.
The tire players went to bed early.
questions.explain: 乐手接收疲惫——tired players。

questions.q: 哪一句的牌挂对了？（请给我一杯开水）
options: May I have a glass of boiled water?
May I have a glass of boil water?
May I have a glass of boils water?
questions.explain: 烧开过的水——boiled water，动词换装才能当形容词。

questions.q: 哪一句的牌挂对了？（台上唱歌的女孩才六岁）
options: The girl singing on the stage is only six.
The girl sings on the stage is only six.
The sung girl on the stage is only six.
questions.explain: 女孩主动在唱——singing 短语后置紧贴 girl。

questions.q: 哪一句的牌挂对了？（这份说明让人困惑）
questions.explain: 说明发出困惑——confusing。

questions.q: 哪一句的牌挂对了？（被摔坏的鼓已经换新了）
options: The broken drum has been replaced.
The breaking drum has been replaced.
The broke drum has been replaced.
questions.explain: 被摔坏——broken；broke 是过去式不能作定语。

questions.q: 哪一句的牌挂对了？（孩子们对野餐感到兴奋）
options: The children are excited about the picnic.
The children are exciting about the picnic.
The children are excited of the picnic.
questions.explain: 人接收兴奋 excited，搭配 about。

questions.q: 哪一句的牌挂对了？（那真是感人的一幕）
questions.explain: 那一幕发出感动——moving moment。

questions.q: 哪一句的牌挂对了？（他厌倦了每天练同一首曲子）
options: He is tired of practising the same piece every day.
He is tiring of practising the same piece every day.
He is tired of practise the same piece every day.
questions.explain: be tired of + doing——tired 挂人身上，of 后收打包件。

questions.q: 哪一句的牌挂对了？（去年拍的那些照片还在墙上）
options: The photos taken last year are still on the wall.
The photos taking last year are still on the wall.
The photos took last year are still on the wall.
questions.explain: 照片是被拍的——taken 短语后置。

questions.q: 哪一句的牌挂对了？（别叫醒在沙发上睡觉的爷爷）
options: Don't wake up Grandpa sleeping on the sofa.
Don't wake up Grandpa slept on the sofa.
Don't wake up Grandpa sleeps on the sofa.
questions.explain: 爷爷主动在睡——sleeping 短语紧贴其后。

stages.name: 用一用 · 两张牌同台

questions.q: The trip was ___, and we all felt ___.
questions.explain: 旅途发出 tiring，人接收 tired——两张牌各归各位。

questions.q: The ___ audience clapped for the ___ performance.
questions.explain: 观众接收感动 moved；演出发出感动 moving。

questions.q: — You look so ___! — Yes, the game was really ___.
questions.explain: 人 excited，比赛 exciting。

questions.q: The story ___ by Grandpa was about a ___ dragon.
questions.explain: 故事被讲 told（后置）；龙正在睡 sleeping（前置）。

questions.q: Nobody was ___ at the news — it wasn't ___ at all.
questions.explain: 人接收 surprised；消息发出 surprising。

questions.q: The man ___ next to the ___ window is the repairman.
questions.explain: 人主动站着 standing；窗被打破 broken。

questions.q: 大考：I was ___ because the lesson was ___, and even the teacher looked ___.
questions.explain: 我和老师都是接收方 confused；课是发出方 confusing。

questions.q: The ___ leaves on the ground told us autumn had come.
questions.explain: 已经落到地上的叶子——fallen（完成）；falling 是正往下落。

questions.q: The cake ___ this morning smells nice, and the kids waiting for it look ___.
questions.explain: 蛋糕被烤 baked（后置）；孩子接收兴奋 excited。

questions.q: Music ___ at the party made everyone ___.
questions.explain: 音乐被播放 played（后置）；大家接收放松 relaxed。

questions.q: Mind the ___ glass — the window was ___ by the wind.
questions.explain: 两处同一块状态牌：定语「碎掉的」+ G29 被动「被吹破」。

questions.q: The boy ___ the flute is my brother; the flute was ___ in Germany.
questions.explain: 男孩主动吹 playing；笛子被制造 made。

questions.q: Everyone was ___ by the ___ ending of the play.
questions.explain: 人被打动 moved；结局发出惊讶 surprising。

questions.q: The letter ___ to the manager last week hasn't been answered.
questions.explain: 信是被寄出的——sent 短语后置修饰 letter。

questions.q: I'm ___ of watching the same ___ show again and again.
questions.explain: be tired of 厌倦；节目发出无聊 boring。

questions.q: 大考二：The ___ fans waited outside for the singer ___ by millions.
questions.explain: 粉丝接收兴奋 excited；歌手被百万人喜爱 loved（短语后置）。

detective.sentence: The movie was so bored that we all fell asleep.
detective.fixed: The movie was so boring that we all fell asleep.
detective.clue: 电影是发出无聊的一方——牌要挂 boring；bored 留给看电影的人。

detective.sentence: My cousin is interesting in collecting stamps.
detective.fixed: My cousin is interested in collecting stamps.
detective.clue: 想说「感兴趣」——人是听众戴 -ed；interesting 成了自夸「我很有趣」。

detective.sentence: The news was surprised, and nobody believed it.
detective.fixed: The news was surprising, and nobody believed it.
detective.clue: 消息发出惊讶——-ing；surprised 是留给听消息的人的牌。

detective.sentence: Do you know the boy stood under the big tree?
detective.fixed: Do you know the boy standing under the big tree?
detective.clue: 一句只有一个主奏（Do you know）——修饰男孩要用分词短语 standing，紧贴其后。

detective.sentence: This is a postcard writing in French.
detective.fixed: This is a postcard written in French.
detective.clue: 明信片是被写的——接受方用 written；writing 成了明信片自己提笔。

detective.sentence: We were exciting when our team won the match.
detective.fixed: We were excited when our team won the match.
detective.clue: 人是接收方——excited；exciting 留给比赛本身。

detective.sentence: The trip was tired, so everyone felt tiring.
detective.fixed: The trip was tiring, so everyone felt tired.
detective.clue: 两张牌全挂反了——旅途发出 tiring，人接收 tired。
